# Snapply

> Snapply is a Chrome extension for UK job seekers. It fills job application forms from your CV (personal details, work history, education, CV upload and saved answers such as notice period and right to work), drafts cover letters only from your real CV, and never submits for you. Works on Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Teamtailor, TalentLink, NHS Jobs and TRAC. Free for 5 applications a month; paid Pro plans for more.

- [Homepage](https://snapply.co.uk/): what Snapply does, pricing and FAQ
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/snapply/pbciplmicohoeflmnjapakibfgbmjcmb)
- [Privacy policy](https://snapply.co.uk/privacy)
